cells.quote: The closing session domain also showed a significant model (F = 40.36; p = 5.18949E‐10), indicating a good model fit. However, the significant variability over the years in the closing session domain suggests that students have shown higher variability in communication within this category over time, as the scores have increased; this is a positive trend. This further means that students' performance in this area has steadily improved, indicating a positive trajectory in learning outcomes.
cells.note: The study compares performance across years using linear regression; students were not randomly assigned.

cells.note: The positive direction is the authors' interpretation of year-over-year regression trends; the design is observational.
